'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Aftermath of the Falklands War]]
**[[Land mines in the Falkland Islands]]
***The [[Falkland Islands]] are declared [[land mine]]-free, 38 years after the end of the [[Falklands War|war]]. [https://www.forces.net/news/falklands-cleared-landmines-after-1982-war (Forces)]
*[[Tigray War]]
**State-affiliated TV reports that [[Ethiopian Armed Forces]] have seized [[Humera Airport]] in the [[Tigray Region]]. Hundreds have been killed since the intervention broke out last week as the [[African Union]] calls for an immediate end to the conflict. [[Prime Minister of Ethiopia|Prime Minister]] [[Abiy Ahmed]] ordered airstrikes and an offensive after an alleged attack on a federal military base by forces of the [[Tigray People's Liberation Front]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-conflict/african-bloc-urges-ceasefire-as-ethiopia-claims-airport-in-tigray-idUSKBN27Q0JG?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[European Union competition law]], [[criticism of Amazon]]
**The [[European Union]] files [[antitrust]] charges against [[Amazon (company)|Amazon]], accusing the company of abusing its position as the top [[online retail]]er in [[France]] and [[Germany]] by using data from sellers to determine what offers to make and what products to launch for their own branded goods. The antitrust commission also opens a second investigation into similar charges against Amazon. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/11/10/tech/amazon-eu-antitrust/index.html (CNN)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Illinois]]
*****[[Illinois]] reports 12,623 new confirmed and probable cases in the last 24 hours, a new single-day record since the beginning of the pandemic. In addition, the number of cumulative cases surpasses 500,000. [https://www.chicagotribune.com/coronavirus/ct-coronavirus-illinois-hospitalizations-20201110-a7i2ozs5xvhntk645hwe3xr26i-story.html (''Chicago Tribune'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
*****[[Michigan]] reports 6,473 new cases, a new single-day record. [https://www.clickondetroit.com/health/2020/11/10/michigan-coronavirus-cases-up-to-223277-death-toll-now-at-7724/ (WDIV-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Texas]]
*****[[Texas]] reports 10,865 new cases in the last 24 hours, a new single-day record since the pandemic began. [https://dfw.cbslocal.com/2020/11/10/texas-daily-record-new-coronavirus-cases/ (KTVT-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Wisconsin]]
*****[[Wisconsin]] reports 7,073 new cases and 66 deaths in the past 24 hours, new single-day records since the pandemic began. In addition, the positivity rate reaches a record high of 35.37%. [https://www.wbay.com/2020/11/10/wisconsin-sets-new-records-for-coronavirus-cases-hospitalizations/ (WBAY-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iowa]]
*****[[Governor of Iowa|Iowa Governor]] [[Kim Reynolds]] extends the state of emergency and announces new restrictions on public gatherings amid a rise of cases in the [[Iowa|state]]. [https://www.kwqc.com/2020/11/10/iowa-officials-report-4441-new-coronavirus-cases-27-more-deaths-over-24-hours/ (KWQC-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Minnesota]]
*****[[Governor of Minnesota|Minnesota Governor]] [[Tim Walz]] announces new restrictions amid a rise of cases in the [[Minnesota|state]]. Indoor and outdoor gatherings will have a 10-person limit, bars and restaurants will close indoor dining service at 10 p.m. [[Central Time Zone|CST]], and indoor capacity will be reduced to 50% of people. [https://minnesota.cbslocal.com/2020/11/11/gov-tim-walz-announces-new-covid-19-restrictions-earlier-restaurant-and-bar-closing-times/ (WCCO-TV)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/covid-restrictions-minnesota-case-spikes-tim-walz/ (CBS News)]
****61,964 hospitalizations are reported in the [[United States]], a new record high surpassing the previous record on April 15 and the first time that there are more than 60,000 Americans hospitalized for COVID-19. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/nicholasreimann/2020/11/10/us-breaks-covid-hospitalization-record-which-had-stood-for-almost-7-months/ (''Forbes'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Ontario]] reports 1,388 new cases of COVID-19 infections in the last 24 hours, a new single-day record since the pandemic began. [https://toronto.ctvnews.ca/ontario-logs-another-record-breaking-number-of-new-covid-19-cases-1.5182353 (CFTO-DT)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bosnia and Herzegovina]]
****[[Bosnia and Herzegovina]] announces a nighttime curfew between 11:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m. local time beginning tomorrow as part of a measure to reduce the spread of COVID-19. It also will limit indoor and outdoor gatherings to 30 people. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/bosnia-imposes-nighttime-curfew-to-contain-coronavirus/2039107 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bulgaria]]
****[[Bulgaria]] reports 107 new fatalities in the last 24 hours, a new single-day record and the first time the country has reported more than 100 deaths since the [[pandemic]] began. [https://m.novinite.com/articles/206468/COVID-19+in+Bulgaria%3A+3818+New+Cases%2C+Record+Death+Toll (Novinite)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark]]
****[[Prime Minister of Denmark|Prime Minister]] [[Mette Frederiksen]] halts a plan to kill more than 15 million [[mink]]s in [[Denmark]] to contain a [[Coronavirus|coronavirus]] mutation due to opposition from [[Members of Parliament|MP]]s to pass a bill that would authorize the slaughter. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2020/11/10/denmark-halts-mink-cull/ (''The Washington Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports 580 new fatalities in the past 24 hours, the highest daily total since April 14, as more regions across the country face new restrictions. [https://www.ansa.it/english/news/general_news/2020/11/10/covid-580-victims-35098-new-cases_b0525993-67db-4dc8-a36b-2bc7f653b353.html (ANSA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Mayor of Moscow|Moscow Mayor]] [[Sergei Sobyanin]]  announces that the city will limit operating hours at clubs, bars and restaurants for two months between November 13 until January 15, 2021. Under the new rules, these establishments will not be allowed to serve customers from 11:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. local time. However, the restrictions do not apply to take-away services. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2020/11/10/moscow-curbs-late-night-club-restaurant-hours-as-coronavirus-surges-a72005 (''The Moscow Times'')] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****The [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Health Ministry]] announces that [[Spain]] will receive 20 million [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] doses from [[Pfizer]] and [[BioNTech]] by early 2021. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/roberthart/2020/11/10/20-million-doses-of-pfizers-covid-19-vaccine-headed-to-spain-in-early-2021/amp/ (''Forbes'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports 532 new fatalities in the last 24 hours, the highest single-day total since May 12, bringing its death toll to 49,770. Meanwhile, weekly deaths surpass 1,000 for the first time since June. [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-uk-records-532-covid-related-deaths-highest-since-mid-may-12129355 (Sky News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] imposes new restrictions that order restaurants and non-essential businesses in [[Tehran]] to close at 6:00 p.m. local time for the next month, in order to curb the worsening spread of COVID-19 that threatens to overwhelm hospitals. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/business-news/iran-to-impose-business-curfew-in-capital-as-coronavirus-surges/story-3XYIm54kD1RewuP3WBHjsO.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Lebanon]], [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns]]
****[[Prime Minister of Lebanon|Caretaker Prime Minister]] [[Hassan Diab]] announces a two-week full [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] from November 14 - 30, after localized lockdown measures fail to stem the surge of [[COVID-19]] cases. [http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Lebanon-News/2020/Nov-10/514142-lebanon-to-go-under-full-lockdown-from-saturday-diab.ashx (''Daily Star'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the State of Palestine]]
****[[Palestine Authority|Palestinian]] chief negotiator [[Saeb Erekat]] dies at the age of 65 due to complications from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/11/10/middleeast/saeb-erekat-palestinian-negotiator-dies-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2018 Toronto van attack]]
**The [[defendant]] in the attack that killed 10 people pleads "not criminally responsible" for the incident saying he has a mental illness. Under [[Canadian law]], his lawyers will have to prove that he has a mental illness that kept him from understanding either what he was doing, or that what he was doing was wrong. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-54895219 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2020 Jordanian general election]]
**Citizens of [[Jordan]] cast their votes in a [[Elections in Jordan|general election]] after the country's [[House of Representatives (Jordan)|House of Representatives]] was dissolved in September. The election takes place during a rapid surge of new [[COVID-19 pandemic in Jordan|COVID-19 infections]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/11/10/jordan-holds-parliamentary-elections-amid-coronavirus-surge (Al Jazeera)]
